rightsReview.individualCreator: Not listed by publisher; credit Coverr without inventing a person.
rightsReview.modelRelease: Publisher states it holds releases for stock people; individual release not independently inspected.
rightsReview.restrictions: Use as an instructional app component with original cues; no standalone stock resale/redistribution, ownership/endorsement claim, AI training or unlicensed trademarks.

entries.changes: Continuous source interval 1.125–8.000 seconds, two complete natural-speed repetitions; moderate saturation/contrast/brightness/gamma correction, resized to 960x540, normalized to 24fps, H.264 compression. No crop, reverse, generated movement, interpolation, sound or added video text.
entries.durationReason: Owner removed the fixed five-second rule and prioritized accurate complete demonstration. This continuous 6.875s interval preserves two complete repetitions and support at both ends at recorded speed.

review.method: All 165 final CRF24 frames inspected sequentially, start/bottom/end and compression candidates reviewed. Continuous parallel-bar support, controlled descent/press, bent knees/free feet, no assistance pad or added load.
review.limitations: Internal visual review, not independent trainer certification or physical-phone acceptance. Outdoor setting differs from the reference gym; camera moves gently sideways. Near-side shoulder/elbow/grip remain readable; the far arm is partly occluded and feet approach the lower edge during descent. No exact joint-angle or all-use model/property-rights guarantee.

poster.description: JPEG decoded from the actual first frame of the final MP4.

visualStandard.acceptanceBasis: Owner prioritizes exercise match and full clear execution without fixed duration. Neutral clothing/black bars/muted green floor improve continuity; not claimed to be the same dark indoor scene.

compression.reference: Lossless FFV1 after identical grade/scale/fps; aligned settb=1/24,setpts=N for SSIM.
